name: Web3 Wallet Risk Scorer API
shortDescription: Score wallet risk from caller-supplied features (age, tx count, approvals, flags)
description: Deterministic wallet-risk rubric over caller-supplied features — age, transaction count, unique counterparties, token approvals, unlimited approvals, failed-transaction ratio, and mixer/flagged-counterparty signals. Returns a 0–100 risk score, a band (low/medium/high/severe), and per-factor contributions with mitigants. It scores the facts you pass in (no chain fetch), so it is advisory, not a verdict on a real address. Mixer/flagged signals force at least a high band. No LLM. /score scores, /lookup adds reasoning and guidance.
